messages:
Liam: Heads-up — SentryTech just uploaded their vendor security questionnaire (CAIQ + custom controls). Can someone from security pick this up? They need answers and a short attestation for our AE by EOD Wed. Link: https://rwd-internal.s3/sentrytech_questionnaire_2026.pdf
sec-bot: Created ticket TICKET-2314 for SentryTech questionnaire. Assigned: unassigned. SLA: 72h.
Priya: I'll triage. @Nadia can you take the controls mapping? I'll own the attestation draft. Need to confirm: will POC use customer data or synthetic?
Nadia: I can do the mapping. Do we have their control scope? Quick skim: they want KMS/HSM details, SOC2 report, VPC + data residency, incident response contact, and vulnerability scan cadence.
Jordan: From sales — POC will run in a Dedicated sandbox in us-west-2 with synthetic data, no PII. Customer wants to see SOC2, encryption at rest, and ability to bring-your-own-key.
Evan: FYI we have SOC2 Type II report for 2025 and KMS BYOK docs. Will attach links. Also we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments; for Dedicated we can offer a KMS integration via partner.
Priya: Good. Nadia — can you map CAIQ controls to our docs and mark any gaps? If we have gaps, list compensating controls and ETA to close.
Nadia: Will do. I'll start with sections A1, A6, and A10. ETA EOD Tue. Adding note: we don't currently have SOC3; need to be explicit.
Liam: Sales needs a short one-page attestation + answers to about 120 Qs. If anything > 1 day, flag here.
sec-bot: TICKET-2314 updated — owner: Nadia; reviewer: Priya; due: 2005150000.
Nadia: Quick question — customer asks for vulnerability scan frequency and whether we publish remediation SLAs. We run weekly internal scans and quarterly external; remediation SLA is based on severity: critical <72h, high <14d. Is that okay to disclose?
Evan: Yes, disclose that. Add that we do yearly third-party pen test and can provide summary.
Jordan: They're also asking about data residency — can we guarantee EU-only for this customer? They want to host in eu-west-1.
Priya: For Dedicated/Private yes. For Hosted we route by region; we can offer Private deployment with EU-only controls — needs Sales-OPS. Jordan, can you open a private deployment request if they buy Dedicated?
Jordan: Will do if they sign. For POC they just want to test model outputs; we can spin Dedicated trial for 2 weeks.
Nadia: Mapping note: CAIQ control CCM-1.2 maps to our KMS doc: https://rwd.docs/controls/kms-byok. I'll attach mapping CSV.
Liam: Thanks. Can we have a draft answers doc by EOD Tue so sales can start feeding back?
Priya: Yes. I'll post draft in this thread when ready. tagging: @Liam @Jordan :eyes: 
Jordan: Thanks team. If Nadia needs access to SentryTech portal ping me.
Nadia: Got it. Starting now.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled — follow-up in 24h for TICKET-2314.
